frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root marks a PRIMARY ANCHORING TERMINUS / HEAD-POLE of a relation: the reference-point to which other elements are traced, referred, or attached. Depending only on the construction that frames it, this head-pole surfaces as (a) the origin/first term of an ordered series (أوّل / الأولى / الأوّلون), (b) the ground or resolution a sign 'reverts to' (تأويل), (c) the progenitor/head a household reverts to (آل), and (d) the bearer/holder an attribute is anchored to (أولو / أولات). The constant residue is 'the defining primary pole that a thing goes back / belongs / is referred to' — never a mid-series, dependent, or non-anchoring member.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The root marks a PRIMARY ANCHORING TERMINUS / HEAD-POLE of a relation: the reference-point to which other elements are traced, referred, or attached. Depending only on the construction that frames it, this head-pole surfaces as (a) the origin/first term of an ordered series (أوّل / الأولى / الأوّلون), (b) the ground or resolution a sign 'reverts to' (تأويل), (c) the progenitor/head a household reverts to (آل), and (d) the bearer/holder an attribute is anchored to (أولو / أولات). The constant residue is 'the defining primary pole that a thing goes back / belongs / is referred to' — never a mid-series, dependent, or non-anchoring member.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across every form-family the root contributes 'the head-anchor of a relation,' with the construction supplying which relation. (1) ORDINAL/ORIGIN pole — أوّل مرة 'the originating instance' (17:51 فطركم أوّل مرّة; 36:79; 6:94; 41:21), أوّل بيت 'the first/founding House' (3:96), أوّل يوم (9:108), أوّل المسلمين/المؤمنين/العابدين/الكافر 'the foremost/lead one' (39:12; 7:143; 43:81; 2:41), and the divine الأوّل paired with الآخر (57:3) — the origin-pole of all being. The feminine الأولى names the primary/prior member of a two-term set: المَوتة/النَّشأة/الخَلق الأولى vs الآخرة (37:59; 56:62; 50:15), الأولى والآخرة 'the first (life) and the last' (53:25; 28:70; 93:4). الأوّلون/الأوّلين = the anchor-generations of human time, 'the ancients' one traces back to (أساطير الأوّلين 8:31; سنّة الأوّلين 35:43; آباؤنا الأوّلون 37:17). (2) REVERSION-TO-GROUND pole — تأويل is the terminus a sign is referred to: of a dream/saying, its true referent/realization (تأويل الأحاديث/الأحلام 12:6, 12:21, 12:44; تأويل رؤياي 12:100), of an act, its underlying reason (18:82 ذلك تأويل ما لم تسطع), of a warning, its eschatological fulfilment (7:53 هل ينظرون إلا تأويله يوم يأتي تأويله; 10:39), of an ambiguous verse, its ground of meaning (3:7), and أحسن تأويلا 'best in final outcome' (17:35; 4:59). Note the pole here sits at the END/ground rather than the beginning — the same 'terminus one reverts to,' the classical آل يؤول. (3) PROGENITOR-HEAD pole — آل X = the folk defined by anchoring to a named head: آل فرعون (2:49; 7:130; 40:46), آل لوط (15:59), آل يعقوب/إبراهيم/عمران (19:6; 4:54; 3:33), آل داود (34:13). (4) BEARER pole — أولو/أولي/أولوا/أولات X = 'the ones to whom X is attributed/belongs': أولو الألباب 'possessors of understanding' (2:269; 3:190; 39:9 and ~16×), أولو القوة/بأس (28:76; 27:33; 48:16), أولو الأرحام/القربى (33:6; 4:8), أولو الأمر (4:59; 4:83), أولو الأبصار/العلم/النهى (59:2; 3:18; 20:128), أولات الأحمال/حمل (65:4; 65:6). Finally the comparative أولى بـ 'nearer / having prior claim' (33:6 النبيّ أولى بالمؤمنين; 8:75 أولى ببعض) is precedence = proximity to the head-position. In every case the root names a primary anchoring pole; the frame decides whether that pole is temporal-origin, meaning-ground, progenitor, or bearer.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Subtracted layers: (a) FORM — verbal-noun form II تأويل (assign/refer-back nominalization), adjective/ordinal الأوّل/الأولى/الأوّلون, the suppletive quasi-noun أولو/أولات (functioning as oblique plural of ذو), the construct noun آل, and the comparative أولى. (b) CONSTRUCTION — أوّل + series/genitive → origin-term; أولو/أولات + genitive attribute → bearer; آل + proper name → head-anchored household; تأويل + object/pronoun → the ground/outcome referred-to; أولى + bi- → priority-over. These frames alone generate the surface differences (first-in-time vs possessor vs progenitor vs meaning-ground). (c) PARTICIPANTS — Pharaoh's people, Joseph's dream-clients, understanding-bearers, God — irrelevant to the residue. (d) CONTEXT — Yusuf dream-interpretation, eschatology (الأولى/الآخرة, يوم الفصل), legal (أولو الأرحام, أولات الأحمال), Exodus narrative (آل فرعون), self-designation (أوّل المسلمين) — all removable. What remains invariant after subtraction is solely: 'the primary anchoring pole/terminus of a relation, that to which the other terms are referred or attached.'
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The أولو/أولات 'possessors-of' family (e.g. 2:269 أولوا الألباب; 65:4 أولات الأحمال; 4:59 أولي الأمر) is the hardest, because 'possessor of X' shows no temporal firstness and looks like a bare grammatical suppletive for ذو with no distinctive root content. Reconciliation: the root still fixes the entity as the ANCHORING HEAD to which the attribute (understanding, command, wombs, a carried child) is referred/attributed — the same head-pole residue, with the genitive-attribute construction (not the root) supplying the possessive rather than the temporal reading. This is genuine but the most inferential link, which is why the disposition is MODERATE, not STRONG. A secondary hard case, تأويل as eschatological outcome (7:53 يوم يأتي تأويله), puts the pole at the END rather than the beginning; but this is reconciled by design, since the invariant is 'terminus one reverts to,' which the data itself lets sit at either the origin (أوّل) or the resolution (تأويل).
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Strongest alternative: the root simply means 'firstness / temporal precedence.' This cleanly covers Family A (أوّل, الأولى, الأوّلون) and أولى 'having prior claim,' and is the most surface-obvious reading. It fails, however, for آل (a household carries no 'firstness'), for أولو (possessors are not 'first'), and it strains تأويل (interpretation/outcome is not 'being first'). Internal evidence arbitrates: (i) 21:104 كما بدأنا أوّل خلق and 9:13 بدأوكم أوّل مرّة pair the inceptive verb بدأ with أوّل, showing أوّل is not the act of beginning but the ranked origin-term/pole; (ii) تأويل in 7:53 explicitly points FORWARD to the day of fulfilment (يوم يأتي تأويله), so the root cannot be 'first' — it is the reference-terminus of tracing, which can lie at either pole; (iii) the fixed antithesis الأوّل/الآخر (57:3) and الأولى/الآخرة frames Awl as one bounding pole against its opposite. 'Head-anchor / reference-terminus of a relation' therefore subsumes 'firstness' as its temporal special case while also covering آل, أولو, and telic تأويل, which plain 'firstness' cannot.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest neighbors: بَدَأ (b-d-') 'to originate/begin' names the inceptive ACTION; Awl names the ranked origin-TERM one reverts to (contrasted within 21:104). قَبْل (q-b-l) 'before' is bare positional anteriority; Awl is a defining head-pole (possessor/progenitor/ground), not mere sequence. آخِر ('-x-r) 'last/other' is the explicit opposite bounding pole (الأوّل والآخر, الأولى والآخرة) — Awl = origin/primary pole, آخِر = terminal pole. ذو / أَهْل: أولو overlaps ذو 'possessor' and آل overlaps أهل 'folk,' but Awl specifically marks the anchoring HEAD of the relation (آل فرعون = those anchored to a named head; أولو الألباب = bearers to whom the attribute is referred). رَجَع / عاد 'return': تأويل's reversion overlaps them, but Awl lexicalizes the reference-terminus/ground reverted-to, not the motion of returning. Falsifiability: the unity breaks if any Awl-form denoted a non-anchoring, dependent, or mid-series member — e.g. أوّل meaning 'middle/second,' or أولو/آل used with no head/attribute/progenitor relation at all. No such occurrence exists in the 170.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty residue — 'the primary anchoring terminus / head-pole of a relation, that to which other terms are traced, referred, or attached' — is recoverable in all 170 occurrences once form and construction are subtracted: it surfaces as origin-term (أوّل, الأولى, الأوّلون), meaning/outcome-ground (تأويل), progenitor-head (آل), and attribute-bearer (أولو/أولات), with the comparative أولى as priority=proximity-to-the-head. Internal data, not etymological recall, drives this: بَدَأ is paired with (hence distinct from) أوّل; تأويل is fixed to the FORWARD terminus in 7:53, ruling out plain 'firstness'; and the الأوّل/الآخر and الأولى/الآخرة antitheses frame the root as one bounding pole. I decline STRONG because the unifying center is underdetermined in direction (the pole sits at the origin for أوّل but at the ground/end for تأويل) and because the أولو 'possessor' family reconciles only through an abstract 'anchoring-head' inference rather than surface transparency. I decline UNRESOLVED because no occurrence is absent or contradicted: none names a dependent or mid-series member, and the possessor and telic-outcome cases genuinely reduce to the head-pole residue via construction-subtraction rather than forcing. Hence PREFERRED / MODERATE, with the أولو family honestly flagged as the weakest (though recoverable) link and none placed in inconsistent_refs.

adversarial_verification.notes:
Refutation attempt: I swept all 170. The candidate's reversion/priority core is genuinely strong and covers the large majority: أوّل مرة/بيت/يوم, أوّل المسلمين/المؤمنين/الكافر, الأوّل vs الآخر (57:3), الأولى as first-of-a-two-term-set (المَوتة/النَّشأة/الخَلق الأولى vs الآخرة), الأوّلون/الأوّلين (ancients one traces back to), تأويل (the ground/outcome a sign reverts to), and أولى بـ (prior claim = proximity to head). For these the أوّل↔آخر opposition is a clean, falsifiable discriminator, so the core survives refutation.

Two seams genuinely fail or are saved only by broadening: (1) OVER-BREADTH — أولو/أولي/أولات is the suppletive plural of ذو "possessor of X"; the "bearer-pole an attribute is anchored to" gloss is just "possessor" restated and carries none of the alleged first/origin/reversion/priority content. It fails to discriminate against ذو. Hardest cases where even 'primary/defining pole' is strained: 4:95 أولي الضرر (the disabled — a deficiency, not a primacy pole), 73:11 أولي النعمة (affluent mockers, pejorative), 11:116 أولوا بقية, 35:1 أولي أجنحة (angels merely 'with wings'). (2) INTERNAL CONTRADICTION — آل X: the root-word آل names the family/folk = the belongers/dependents, while the real anchoring head is فرعون/لوط/يعقوب/داود (NOT the root-word). This violates the frozen residue's own clause 'never a ... dependent.' It is rescuable only by redefining 'pole' into 'membership-relation defined by a head,' an ad-hoc move. Representative failures: 15:59 آل لوط, 2:49 & 40:46 آل فرعون (the class extends to all ~24 آل occurrences and to the full أولو set).

Neighbor-root contrast / distinctiveness (set false): at exactly these seams the contribution collapses into neighbors — آل ≈ أهل ('folk of'), أولو ≈ ذو ('possessor of'), أوّل ≈ أصل ('origin'). 'Primary anchoring pole of a relation' is elastic enough to absorb all three, so it does not cleanly discriminate. Notably these are the two forms classical lexicography disputes as historically separate lexemes. Falsifiable (set true): the residue states a testable condition ('never a mid-series, dependent, or non-anchoring member'), and the آل occurrences arguably meet that failure condition. Net: a strong, distinct reversion/priority core with two homonym-suspect branches (آل, أولو) held together only by broadening — PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, not a full homonymy REFUTED and not clean enough for SUPPORTED.
